theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: Eligible, trend-gate-passing leadership with durability at the 0.5 bar and uncrowded texture (crowding_z 0.15, crowded=false). It is the only eligible theme whose momentum rank and trend-gate both hold within the shrinking eligible set; lean is a stay-with-the-leader call on the staying-power leg, not a momentum forecast.
theses.dissent: Breadth is thin (0.125) and durability is exactly at the bar with mixed Hurst — leadership may be a narrow, fading concentration that stalls once the energy complex rotates through.

falsifier.text: SMH lags the S&P 500 by 6% over any rolling 10-day window before the 20-day check-by date

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Eligible, trend-passing, and showing the strongest breadth among leaders (0.636) with near-high crowding (0.93) but not flagged. The rotation margin over the challenger is narrow (0.185), so this is a durability-plus-breadth lean on the staying-power leg rather than a momentum continuation call.
theses.dissent: Crowding is near the top of its unflagged range and durability is mixed-Hurst; if the energy complex is an over-owned inflation-trade relic, breadth could unwind quickly against a macro regime favoring growth.

falsifier.text: XLE loses the trend gate (eligible flips false) OR breadth falls below 0.4 before the 20-day check-by date

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Best trend-health profile among crowded eligible themes: trend Hurst, 0.75 durability (top-tier), 0.6 breadth. Crowding flag (1.61) is a size-down caution only, not a fade; the validated gate logic keeps this in the eligible stack, so lean stays positive but hedged in spirit.
theses.dissent: Crowded with a high crowding_z; crowding marks tops on inflow spikes, and a crowded trend-Hurst theme is vulnerable to a sharp de-grossing if the broader tape turns.

falsifier.text: CIBR gives back half its trailing 30-day gain while breadth drops below 0.5 before the 20-day check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
